chunks: Say: "Who will save you from God if He decide to afflict you or show you His mercy?" They will never find a friend or helper apart from God.
ai.seo_question: Who can protect us from God's decree according to the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the absolute sovereignty of Allah (Tawhid al-Ilahi) while often being contextualized with the concept of divine will preceding intercession (Shafa'ah). It clarifies that while the Ahl al-Bayt and prophets serve as intermediaries, their authority is entirely derived from and subordinate to God's decree, refuting any notion of independent power. This reinforces the Shia understanding that all protection and aid ultimately trace back to the Divine Will, with the Imams acting as the specific channels of that mercy.
